title: CHAPTER - 2 INMATE POPULATION IN DIFFERENT JAILS An important aspect in Prison administration is the population that the authorities have to handle in the Prisons. A major problem that is being faced in most of the Indian Jails is overcrowding of Prisons which leads to inadequate infrastructure facilities and lack of essential services to the Prison inmates. In order to find relation between the capacity available in the Prisons and the population of Prison inmates, data regarding the population of the inmates both male and female is collected from the Prison authorities.
